create_microbatch: create a microbatched function that evaluates fun sequentially on subsets of data to reduce peak memory usage
create_micro_vmap: create a generalized vmap function that supports microbatching to process large batch axes without running out of memory
create_micro_grad: create a per-example gradient function that computes, transforms, and sums gradients across microbatches with auxiliary metrics
build_accumulator: build a custom Accumulator with init, update, finalize, and aggregate functions to define how microbatch results are combined
use_accumulation_type: use AccumulationType enum values MEAN, SUM, RUNNING_MEAN, or CONCAT to specify how microbatch outputs are aggregated
